title: Vermin Rapture
description: Pest control that gently persuades every roach and rat to walk out, settle their affairs, and ascend to a better infestation.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-smooth
lines.text: Bugs in the walls? One spray, and every roach gently walks out to ascend to a better infestation. <p:0.2> Vermin Rapture... they leave smiling.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: The pests do not leave. <p:0> They unionize. <p:0> Walls now load-bearing with rats. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
